mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 53 degrees with clear skies near the Verona Public Library and a waxing gibbous moon. The overnight low will be 48 degrees with no rain expected, and you can catch the International Space Station crossing the sky starting at 8:30 PM, rising near Verona High School and heading toward Fitchburg.

The City of Verona is hosting a free e-waste drop-off event at the recycling center on October 17, and the Verona Police Department is actively hiring new patrol officers to join their community-oriented team.
Today you can head to Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company for trivia, while tomorrow features the downtown farmers market and more trivia nights at the Bogey Factory.
In a notable weekly report, officers responded to a burglary on September 10 where a suspect was apprehended after firing a shot while breaking into a building.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently closed for a scheduled remodel, so please look forward to their return.
